chapter: Chicago clubs, entertainers and tent shows
title: Hearing King Oliver's band at the Royal Garden as a summer visitor
summary: He heard Oliver's band at the Royal Garden while visiting Chicago on vacation and saw the Dreamland in Bill Bottoms' day, knowing few of the Oliver sidemen.

story.theme_name: Chicago: the jazz migration and its clubs
story.community_name: Going north: working the Chicago jazz scene

blocks.x: Did you ever hear, I guess you didn't hear Bill Johnson's band at the Royal Garden?
No, I didn't hear Bill Johnson, although I did hear a band at the Royal Garden, I don't remember, I thought it had -- it was King Oliver's band --
-- that was the band that I heard at the Royal Garden.
Right that was a little later.
Now you say the Dreamland, by the time you got to it, you went in there with Al Wynn Williams --
But you did go to it while Bill Bottoms was running it?
Do you remember his two floormen, Johnny Brown and Bill George?
What about some of the members of the Oliver band, the Dodds Brothers, Dutrey, did you know any of them?
I met a few of them, but you see, at that time, when I saw or heard Oliver's band at the Royal Garden, I wasn't playing there, I was just there on a vacation.
